caption:
No placeholder postings and no remote tracking databases.

The live jobs panel in JobRez lists real roles directly from company careers pages on Lever, Greenhouse, and Ashby boards, alongside Adzuna and direct employer posts. Every listing links back to the original posting, with zero sample or placeholder listings.

Your application tracking stays local. Statuses including Saved, Applied, Interviewing, Offer, and Closed are stored directly in your browser rather than on a remote server.

Explore the live jobs panel at jobrez.com.
